## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D car game inspired by Need for Speed customization, Forza car selection, and The Crew’s open-world map.

## Requirements
- Deliver a playable game without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for visual checks.

## Decisions
- Built a browser-based Three.js arcade driving game with an original “APEX / Coastline” theme.
- Used a fictional coastal island, five selectable cars, and paint color customization.

## Work State
